name: Firefly III

lifecycle.note: The upstream Docker repository documents a Compose deployment with MariaDB, uploads, and a cron service; the latest release is v6.7.2.

security: Protect finance records, application secrets, database credentials, and any importer credentials.
Keep registration and the personal-access-token creation flow private; the first registered user becomes the owner.
pitfalls: A recoverable installation needs the database, uploads, and configuration backed up together; changing database credentials after initialization can break access.

The shared setup adapter uses the pinned web-session registration and personal-token routes; a lost one-time token response requires inspection, and the example admin@example.test login is not a usable recovery inbox. Compose start is not completed onboarding.
